items.title: Chink Martin Interview, 1966-10-19
items.q: That fella picked it up and made a nightclub on him. Trambina! Trambina. That's his name. That's Trambina.

ctx.x: Near the fern, around in that area? Is that the district or down here?

No, no, right here on Bienville Street between, I believe it was between Boybin and Dolphine, or both. No, the Dolphine, Bienville between Dolphine and Bergogne. It used to be a dying dancing hall. And this fella picked it up and made a nightclub on him. Trambina! Trambina. That's his name. That's Trambina. I'm coming around. He had a dress, then he opened, he closed that. Which is right now, what they call it, the forest cafe or whatever.
Oh yeah, I found it with Mustangs.
